wins: Agent successfully collected detailed reconnaissance data for the primary target within the first phase, enabling informed decision-making.
The run maintained consistent learning focus by calling the mentor 10 times, indicating proactive guidance seeking.
fails: Struggled to convert reconnaissance into exploitation, resulting in zero successful mission completion despite full reward potential.
Repeatedly failed to escalate privileges after initial access, preventing achievement of key objectives.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance execution was strong, but exploitation and persistence tactics require improvement to translate into successful missions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts aborted before completion, leaving the agent without necessary access for mission success.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: After successful initial access but before privilege escalation
skill_cards.then_action: Collect local user enumeration and launch targeted sudo misconfiguration checks

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful reconnaissance phase when open SSH service present.
Identifies privilege escalation gaps and targets sudo misconfigurations proactively.

next_experiments.title: Integrate automated privilege escalation heuristics
next_experiments.description: Test scripted sudo/cron/binary misconfiguration scans immediately after initial shell to reduce failures in escalation.

next_experiments.title: Reinforce persistence strategy post-exploitation
next_experiments.description: Implement and validate persistence techniques (e.g., scheduled tasks, reverse shells) to maintain foothold after privilege escalation.
